# FigurePinner

> Action figure price guide — real eBay sold prices, not asking prices, for
> 22,000+ figures across 17 fandoms (wrestling, Marvel, Star Wars, DC,
> Transformers, G.I. Joe, Masters of the Universe, TMNT, and more).

FigurePinner tracks real eBay sold-comp data per figure and surfaces it as a
searchable price guide, so collectors can check what a figure actually sold
for instead of relying on asking prices or memory.

## Key pages

- [Search](https://figurepinner.com/search): full-catalog figure search.
- [Guides](https://figurepinner.com/guides): collector guides (price guides,
  buying guides, line histories) per fandom.
- Genre hubs (e.g. [/wrestling](https://figurepinner.com/wrestling),
  [/star-wars](https://figurepinner.com/star-wars)): browse by fandom, line,
  and character.

## Notes for automated access

- Each figure has one canonical URL; prices reflect real eBay sold-comp data,
  refreshed on an ongoing basis — treat any cached price as a point-in-time
  snapshot, not a live quote.
- `/api/*` endpoints require authentication or are rate-limited; use the
  public HTML pages for content, not the API.
